entries.content_utf8:
# Database settings
[database]
url = "postgres://db.example.com:5432/orders"
pool_size = 10
timeout_seconds = 30

[database.replica]
url = "postgres://replica.example.com:5432/orders"
enabled = false

service: orders
replicas: 2
image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0
resources:
  memory: 512Mi
  cpu: 500m
env:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  REGION: eu-central

[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080
debug = true

[mail]
sender = orders@example.com
smtp = smtp.example.com
